name: 会话总结
description: Session rotation engine + error immune system for AI coding agents. v7 Rotation Mode: produces self-contained rotation reports that substitute full conversation history — real token savings when starting new sessions. Supports 5-dimension error classification, dual-track self-evolution (success + error), 4-tier layered writing (project/global/skill/pending), and 5-level graceful degradation. Triggered only by standalone word '总结' or 'summarize' — not in sentences, no auto-reminder. AI编程助手的会话轮转引擎+错误免疫系统。v7轮转模式：生成自包含的轮转报告替代全量历史——新会话时真实节省token。支持5维错误分类、双轨自进化、4层分级写入、5级降级链。仅独立词'总结'或'summarize'触发。
author: gtbwpkwjnb-alt
